data.title: Build India's Finance Skills Infrastructure
data.subtitle: Not Just a Centre
data.descriptionTextarea: Finance Forum of India (FFOI) invites select institutions and education entrepreneurs to partner in building a national network of finance skills, assessment, and certification centres.
data.descriptionNoteTextarea: This is not a retail franchise model. It is a long-term academic and delivery partnership.

data.label: Understanding the Partnership
data.title: What an FFOI Centre Partnership Is
data.descriptionTextarea: An FFOI Centre Partner operates as a regional delivery hub within a centrally governed national finance ecosystem.
data.footerInput: All under FFOI's central academic, assessment, and certification governance.

data.title: What an FFOI Centre Partnership Is NOT
data.description: To maintain quality and credibility, FFOI is explicit:

items.textInput: Not a "buy a brand & run" model

data.footerInput: FFOI partners with organisations that want to build institutions, not outlets.

data.label: Ideal Partners
data.title: Who Should Explore Centre Partnership?
data.taglineTextarea: If your goal is short-term commercial expansion, this model may not be suitable.

items.descriptionTextarea: Established colleges and universities looking to extend their finance education footprint nationally.
Training bodies with proven delivery capability seeking national alignment and certification.
Visionary entrepreneurs with long-term commitment to building credible finance education institutions.
Entities with existing governance capability, physical infrastructure, and operational readiness.
Regions where finance skill demand is strong but structured, nationally aligned delivery is absent.

data.label: Central Governance & Enablement
data.title: What FFOI Provides
data.subtitleInput: FFOI partners receive comprehensive central support across four pillars.

points: Continuous curriculum updates via corporate feedback
Access to FAAT and future assessments
Alignment with RT MSSU & NCVT pathways
Inclusion in FFOI's national centre network

data.label: Partner Responsibilities
data.title: What the Centre Partner Is Responsible For
data.descriptionTextarea: FFOI governs what is taught, assessed, and certified. Partners govern how it is delivered locally — within standards.

items.textInput: Local faculty deployment (as per FFOI norms)

data.label: Non-Negotiable Standards
data.title: Governance, Quality & Compliance
data.descriptionTextarea: Every FFOI Centre Partner must adhere to central governance.

reserves.textInput: Pause or withdraw partnership if standards are not met

data.footerInput: This protects the credibility of all centres in the network.

data.label: Important Read
data.title: Expansion Philosophy
data.descriptionTextarea: FFOI does not aim to open centres everywhere.

data.label: Interested in Becoming an FFOI Centre Partner?
data.title: Explore Partnership Possibilities
data.descriptionTextarea: If you believe your organisation aligns with FFOI's academic integrity, long-term vision, and governance standards, you may explore partnership possibilities.
data.noteTextarea: This leads to a qualification-based application review, not instant approval.

data.title: Build an Institution. Build India's Finance Future.
